training_rules.checkpoint_rule: Minimum validation negative log density only; strict improvement, ties retain earliest checkpoint. No test-based checkpoint/seed/configuration choice.

criteria.rule: Persist all chains and diagnostic provenance; report failures without replacing the observation.

phase_b_assessment.reason: 9/9 saved runs are verified; used references have three chains versus the original at-least-four-chain criterion and lack reported rank-normalized Rhat and bulk/tail ESS. No data-size optimum is inferred.

limitations: Checkpoints contain selected model state_dict only, without per-epoch losses, optimizer/RNG state or historical per-run input hashes. Thus absence of transient training NaNs/I/O events cannot be proved retrospectively; all retained tensors, forward outputs and replayed samples are finite, and the log has no recorded errors.
Best/last epoch, optimizer steps and wall time can be cross-checked against CSV, log and the fixed rule but cannot be reconstructed from a weights-only checkpoint.

The runner saves weights and rewrites RESULTS.csv after each completed run. Existing pairs are sufficient to skip completed runs on resume; no within-run optimizer checkpoint or atomic CSV replacement is implemented. No interruption occurred in the retained Phase A log.
Runner content is hashed at audit time; it had no historical run-specific hash. The common cai_lib and bank do match earlier recorded hashes.
The frozen protocol retains clean-frequency training noise versus observed-frequency inference noise; no distribution repair was performed.
Three training seeds give descriptive variability, not a validated distribution or an optimum; reference uncertainty is not folded into either seed SD.
